events.title: Northwind Semiconductor lifts 2026 capex guidance by 30%
events.takeaway: Northwind is spending into strength: the raise is funded by prepayments, not debt.
data_points: 2026 capex guided to **NWD 26bn**, up from NWD 20bn three months ago
Customer prepayments reached NWD 7.4bn, covering 28% of the plan
Q4 gross margin 54.1%, up 180bp year on year
Two thirds of the increase goes to advanced packaging, not wafer capacity
events.argument: Consensus expected a flat capex year after two years of expansion. The raise breaks that, but the mix matters more than the size: packaging is where lead times are longest, so this reads as removing a bottleneck rather than adding supply. If prepayments keep funding more than a quarter of the plan, the usual late-cycle balance-sheet risk is muted.
counterpoints: Prepayments can be renegotiated; the last downcycle saw 40% of them deferred
Management raised capex at the 2022 peak too, one quarter before orders rolled over

events.title: Halcyon Cloud cuts inference prices by 40%
events.takeaway: Halcyon is trading margin for share while its unit costs are falling faster than list prices.
data_points: List price for the standard tier falls from $2.50 to $1.50 per million tokens
Halcyon says its serving cost fell 55% over the past year
The cut applies to new and existing contracts from April 1
events.argument: A price cut smaller than the cost decline keeps unit margin intact, so this is less a price war than a pass-through. The open question is whether rivals with older fleets can follow without losing money.
counterpoints: Cost figures are self-reported and exclude depreciation on new capacity

events.title: Orchard Lane Grocers Q4: volumes up, margin flat
events.takeaway: Volume growth returned, but it was bought with promotions.
data_points: Same-store volume +2.3%, the first positive print in five quarters
Operating margin 3.1%, unchanged; promotional intensity up 90bp
counterpoints: One quarter of volume does not make a trend when it coincides with heavier discounting
